# RSTL Centre

Accredited health and safety training, OHS consulting and occupational medicals in South Africa. SAQA-aligned courses delivered online, on-site and at our centres in Midrand, Durban and Mthatha. Daily classes, no waiting period, group discounts.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.rstlcentre.co.za/): Accredited health and safety training overview
- [All Courses](https://www.rstlcentre.co.za/courses): Full course catalogue with prices
- [Soft Skills Courses](https://www.rstlcentre.co.za/soft-skills): Excel, customer service, time management and communication skills
- [Occupational Medicals](https://www.rstlcentre.co.za/medicals): Pre-employment, working at heights, fitness to work
- [Contact & Quotes](https://www.rstlcentre.co.za/contact): Email quote request
